So change SimpleValidationContext extends ValidationContext, etc.

Also remove Mockito imports and annotations. We can remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) and @Mock fields; they are not used anyway. So we can delete those fields and imports.

Simplify: just use the simple stubs.

Also need to adjust code where they cast to SimpleValidationContext; that's fine.

Also need import Set, ValidationMessage.

Add import com.networknt.schema.ValidationMessage; etc.
